$comment: Site Profile: everything the tool knows about the portal. Evidence: docs/recon/. Decisions (D#): docs/PROJECT_PLAN.md section 8. Selectors and cell splits are proven against saved pages in stage B2.

departmentTree.note: A JSON list. Each node holds attr.id (prefix deptid_), attr.dname, attr.dtype, pdeptid and state. id=0 gives the top level. The panel shows its own picker and never opens the portal's popup.

categoryTree.note: A JSON list. id=0 gives the 61 top-level categories. Each node holds attr.id, attr.cpvcode, attr.cpvname, data and state.

categoryExpansion.note: Filters use category names, joined with '; '. Names can contain '; ', so keep chosen names as a list and never split the string.

appProjectCombo.note: param1 is the budget word from valueMap; empty when none is chosen. startDate is the financial year's text.

filters.label: By Financial Year
filters.allLabel: All years, to the current one
filters.note: D65: All loops every year up to the current fiscal year, and only with a Project. Quarter is a date range built from the year, so it's sent with each year: All Four Quarter (flow-1 notes).

filters.label: PE Office
filters.note: D68: with projects chosen, All is one report with office 0, which the portal answers with the project's own figures (live, 2026-11-10). The page has no 'all offices' option. The panel adds All, which loops through every office read live (D12).

filters.label: By Quarter
filters.note: Owner hides it. One option has a typo in its value (E4).

filters.label: By Programme
filters.note: Owner hides it: often returns nothing (E3).

filters.label: By Project
filters.note: D68: Not set by default; one or many chosen from a searchable list, one report each. D65: shown again for the project grab, a searchable list. It often returns nothing (E3, E5), and the page doesn't refresh it when the office changes.

filters.label: Budget Type
filters.note: Left unset, the report returns all three budgets at once.
